rationale: Record that a build-speed telemetry change crosses the design-output-and-packaging selector through docs/status/tools.yaml alone: the build-speed-scorecard registry entry's invocation and outputs lines gain the new `report --split <ISO time>` flag. The rest of the change is build and CI telemetry (the shared local-build metrics recorder, receipt-decision and test-tier annotations, host_vitals probe deadlines). No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold, packaging artifact or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
